feature: Customer Portal v2 Part 8 -- the Projects page (/portal-v2/projects), an SOW-based fixed-scope delivery view. Recreated from the prototype's own `isProjects` block ('Customer Portal Shell.dc.html' 1231-1495), its PJ_PHASES / PJ_TASKS / PJ_LANES / PJ_MILESTONES fixtures (shell 15999-16123) and the pjGanttRows / pjPhaseRail / pjMilestones derivations. The page answers two questions -- how much of the contracted scope is done, and whose move it is -- and arranges everything under them: a back-to-Overview link, the header (SOW-2026-0114 label, title, delivery-lead meta), three summary cards (Waiting on you / With us / Scope delivered), a full phase Gantt reusing the Overview's pjRows/pjPct geometry (ONE shared copy, no forked phases), the phase-deliverables rail, the FLUID 5-lane auto-fit task board, and the footer actions. Fixture lives in projectsData.ts; the geometry is reused from overviewModel via projectsModel and pinned by projectsModel.test.ts.
notes: THE LOGIN BLOCK IS NOT OPTIONAL. /portal-v2/* sits behind ProtectedRoute; a probe that skips the five login steps hits the login screen and every assertion fails for a reason unrelated to the page.

UI ROUTE SHAPE: msp-portal's outer WouterRouter has base '/portal' and SlugScope nests a second router at '/{slug}', so the real URL is /portal/{slug}/portal-v2/projects. App.tsx declares '/portal-v2/projects' BEFORE '/portal-v2/:pillar' so the param route cannot swallow it -- Projects is a plain, param-free route.

shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build, not the local worktree -- the Projects page is new in Part 8, so the dev server must carry this commit before the route resolves. A run against a build that predates the deploy fails at PJ1 (NotFound / login), which is a not-deployed signal, not a page defect.

WHY THE PER-TASK ACTION AND ASK-SHANEBOT BUTTONS ARE NOT CLICKED -- INERT BY DESIGN, ASSERTED PRESENT. In the prototype the 'Confirm the pilot user list' style buttons drive a slide-over FORM (openForm) and 'Ask ShaneBot about this' opens the assistant; both belong to the shell systems (Part 1), not this page, so Part 8 renders them exactly as drawn but inert -- the same call the Change Control rebuild made. Asserting they RENDER is the real assertion: the page was not 'improved' by inventing behaviour, and not trimmed to hide it.

WHAT IS REALLY DRIVEN: the phase-rail toggle (PJ13-PJ15 -- clicking a Gantt phase row opens its deliverables panel, real local UI state) and the nav wiring (PJ16-PJ18 -- the ungrouped Projects nav row navigates to the page). The task-card expand/collapse split, the two card counts and the milestone diamond placement are pinned by src/components/portal-v2/projectsModel.test.ts (unit) rather than re-driven here.

ROUND TWO ITEM 6: the Gantt track (186px minmax(0,1fr)) and the 5-lane board (repeat(auto-fit,minmax(200px,1fr))) are FLUID -- no fixed min-width floor and no overflow-x wrapper. Layout fluidity is a visual property this text-based harness cannot assert; it is verified by eye and stated here so nobody reads a green run as proof of it.
ENV VARS required in BuildConsole -> Settings -> Test Environment Variables: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD.

GIT #1241/#1399 -- the header meta, phases/Gantt, task board, 'With us' list and scope-bar VALUES read from a real project (workflow_steps + kanban_tasks via GET /api/portal/dashboard -> /api/portal/projects/:id -> /api/portal/projects/:id/delivery-kanban-tasks) when the logged-in customer has an active project row; projectsLive.ts/projectsWire.ts. Git #1399 replaced the old two-state 'live'|'fixture' model (which showed the fictional Copilot Readiness Assessment fixture to EVERY account, enrolled or not) with five real states: loading / live / empty (active project, nothing scheduled yet) / unconfigured (no active project) / error (failed read) -- only 'live' and 'empty' show the real project's header meta and arrays; 'unconfigured' and 'error' render an honest NoScanDataState for the whole project body instead of the design fixture. PJ1/PJ2 below assert that honest state is what's actually on screen, and PJ21 reads the hidden pv2-projects-source marker to confirm the real dataState is 'unconfigured', because TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL's account carries no active projectsTable row. A future manifest pass against an enrolled test account should assert 'live'/'empty' and the real header meta/board content instead -- toLiveProjectGeometry/toProjectTasks/toScopeBars/toProjectMeta are pinned directly by projectsWire.test.ts for that live path in the meantime. The schedule narrative (callout/next-milestone text) and the two summary cards' descriptive tail sentences still have no live analogue and stay the design fixture unconditionally once a real project is on screen -- same call PillarLiveSource.tsx's drill-downs already made.

LOADING-STATE FIXTURE FLASH FIX (Git #1365) -- the header, summary cards, Gantt/phase rail and task board render PortalV2LoadingState while the real project read (`/api/portal/dashboard` -> `/api/portal/projects/:id` -> delivery-kanban-tasks) is in flight, instead of the design fixture, matching the pattern #1343 established for Ownership/Change Control. Not asserted with a new uiStep here: the loading window is typically sub-200ms against the dev/test API, so gating a step on it would be a flaky race rather than reliable coverage. PJ1/PJ2/PJ21's settled honest-empty assertions above are the SETTLED (post-loading) state.
